verdict.rationale: Cubic's docs say every PR is scanned for logic errors and security vulnerabilities, not just style (cubic-docs-47, cubic-docs-19). They also describe a deeper multi-pass Ultrareview for complex or risky changes (cubic-docs-48), Datadog log checks to confirm findings (cubic-docs-73), and thumbs-up/down feedback to separate useful comments from noise (cubic-docs-33). One community user reports more technical findings than basic checks (cubic-comm-1). Missing for 10: race-condition and edge-case detection are never documented explicitly, and there is no independent benchmark or hands-on evidence of real-bug catch rate versus false positives.
